classification.difficultyReason: Translate shading into set notation, choosing how complements combine with union or intersection. The hardest regions require recognising that everything except one exclusive region is a union of a complement and the other set.

spec.description: Both overlapping circles shaded; exterior unshaded. Set labels sit below their respective circles inside the rectangle.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading is a supplied given; no answer notation is printed.

answer.worked: The shaded region contains everything in $A$ or $B$, including their overlap: $A\cup B$.

spec.description: Rectangle shaded except for the entire left circle, including the intersection.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading is a supplied given; no answer notation is printed.

answer.worked: Everything outside $A$ is shaded, so the region is $A'$.

spec.description: Rectangle shaded except for the entire right circle, including the intersection.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading is a supplied given; no answer notation is printed.

answer.worked: Everything outside $B$ is shaded, so the region is $B'$.

spec.description: Only the right-circle region outside the left circle is shaded.
spec.mathematics: Intersection of the complement of A with B.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading is a supplied given; no answer notation is printed.

answer.worked: The shaded region is in $B$ and outside $A$: $\overline{A}\cap B$.

spec.description: Everything except the left-circle-only region is shaded.
spec.mathematics: Union of the complement of A with B.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading is a supplied given; no answer notation is printed.

answer.worked: The shading includes everything outside $A$, together with all of $B$: $\overline{A}\cup B$.

spec.description: Everything except the right-circle-only region is shaded.
spec.mathematics: Union of A with the complement of B.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading is a supplied given; no answer notation is printed.

answer.worked: The shading includes all of $A$, together with everything outside $B$: $A\cup\overline{B}$.

spec.description: Only the lens where the circles overlap is shaded.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading is a supplied given; no answer notation is printed.

answer.worked: Only the region belonging to both sets is shaded: $A\cap B$.

spec.description: Only the exterior of both circles is shaded.
spec.mathematics: Complement of the union; equivalently the intersection of both complements.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading is a supplied given; no answer notation is printed.

answer.worked: The shaded region is outside both $A$ and $B$, so it is $\overline{A\cup B}$, equivalently $\overline{A}\cap\overline{B}$.

spec.description: Only the left-circle region outside the right circle is shaded.
spec.mathematics: Intersection of A with the complement of B.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading is a supplied given; no answer notation is printed.

answer.worked: The shaded region is in $A$ and outside $B$: $A\cap\overline{B}$.
